title: Bank of Baroda launches forensic investigation into data breach
summary: The Bank of Baroda has initiated a forensic investigation after critical customer information was allegedly leaked onto the darkweb. The leak is believed to have occurred through a compromised employee email. Branch audit reports, loan appraisal files, and customer account-opening forms are among the documents circulating online. The bank claims its core banking systems were not accessed during the breach. A forensic investigation has been launched to determine the cause of the leak.
summary_points: Bank of Baroda initiated a forensic investigation into a data breach
Critical customer information was allegedly leaked onto the darkweb
The leak is believed to have occurred through a compromised employee email
Branch audit reports, loan appraisal files, and customer account-opening forms were exposed online
The bank claims its core banking systems were not accessed during the breach
title_hi: बैंक ऑफ बारोडा डेटा हैक में जांच शुरू की
summary_hi: बैंक ऑफ बारोडा ने डेटा हैक में एक जांच शुरू की है, जब क्रिटिकल ग्राहक सूचना दुर्भावनापूर्ण इंटरनेट नेटवर्क पर छुप गई थी। यह घटना एक व्यक्तिगत ईमेल के माध्यम से होने का माना जाता है। ब्रांच ऑडिट रिपोर्ट, लोन अप्रेल फाइल्स और ग्राहक खाता-ओपनिंग फॉर्म्स ऑनलाइन प्रस्तुत किए गए थे। बैंक ने अपनी कोर बैंकिंग सिस्टमों को हैक के दौरान पहुंचा नहीं लिया है।
